summary: D006 is the strongest compressed P0002 draft so far, but its witness/oath frame is too ready-made and the numeric MLLW/NAVD88 contrast still behaves like a concept demonstration.
strengths: Stops opening with station metadata and begins from the Marine Inspection Office place-object.
Reduces the source table to one meaningful MLLW/NAVD88 same-high conflict.
Contains a genuinely strong pressure in the idea that nothing drains while the oath changes.
failures: Courtroom witness/oath vocabulary supplies a familiar metaphor too quickly.
The numeric contrast remains the hinge, so the poem is still a lean demonstration of datum relativity.
The source definition of Station Datum and the first tide staff remains more materially promising than the poem's inherited courtroom frame.
required_next_change: D007 should leave witness/oath language behind, use the NOAA Station Datum definition as the central pressure, keep body numbers out, and make the zero of the first tide staff installed carry the poem's action.
non_claim: This review blocks promotion; it is not an admission or evidence judgment.
